questions.prompt: Which way do Wren and Flint choose when the map and spell disagree?
questions.evidenceText:
"Straight ahead," they agreed.
This turned out to be wrong.

questions.prompt: How do Wren and Flint finally find the Whispering Meadow?
choices: They choose the oldest map in Flint's bag.
They wait for Wren's spinning arrow to stop.
questions.evidenceText: Wren and Flint followed the mushroom trail.

questions.prompt: What lesson does reaching the meadow by the mushroom trail show?
choices: Help can come from an unexpected place.
Flint's oldest map led them out of the fog.
Wren's spinning arrow pointed straight to the meadow.
questions.answer: Help can come from an unexpected place.
questions.rationale: After the map and spell fail, Wren asks a mushroom for the way, and its trail leads them to the meadow; this unexpected help shows that help can come from an unexpected place.
questions.evidenceText:
Wren and Flint followed the mushroom trail.
The forest opened up.
The golden light of the Whispering Meadow was ahead.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText:
She spoke to the mushroom.
Very quietly.
She asked it the way.
